title: Summer Intern - Enovia PLM
description:
Are you interested in being part of an innovative team that supports Westinghouse's mission to provide clean energy solutions? At Westinghouse, we recognize that our employees are our most valuable asset and we seek to identify, attract and recruit the most qualified talent while recognizing and encouraging the value of diversity in the global workplace.

About The Role

As an Enovia PLM Developer intern, you will rely on the use of existing frameworks and languages to create applications used by several departments within Westinghouse.

You will report to the Information and Document Management Solutions Manager at our Cranberry facility. This is a paid full-time remote position for the summer, May - August 2027.

Key Responsibilities

Investigate, analyze design and implement solutions using Enovia/3DExperience software and supporting applications
Provide server and client support for Enovia PLM/3DExperience platform
You will help develop new applications and feature enhancements
Complete assigned project activities on time and maintain requirements, test scripts and other documentation

Qualifications:

Pursuing a bachelor's degree in information technology, computer science, or software engineering; engineering
Completed Sophomore year of college
Basic knowledge of web development and programming languages such as HTML5, Java/JPO, MQL, TCL, and JavaScript
Experience developing web applications using TomEE/Tomcat with back-end data services

We are committed to transparency and equity in all of our people practices. The hourly rate for this position, which is dependent upon experience, qualifications and skills, is estimated to be $25.40 to $29.00 per hour.

,
